decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (3 unnumbered drawings Received:  16/04/2010
2 Amended drawings - 23-25Notrthyde received: 19/07/2010)  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The extension  hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 23 North Hyde Lane.
description: Erection of a single storey outbuilding in rear garden of house.
